_comment: Scenery catalog for stage/scenes.py. Coordinates are in 32 px tiles: [col, row, width, height]. Sheets: walls, floors, city, out, terrain, interior, decor, ruins, winter, winter_b (LPC tile packs; `keys` names a flat colour a pack uses for empty cells) and dcss:<path> (one CC0 DCSS png). Walls and floors are [col, row] on the walls/floors sheet, or {"sheet", "at"} on another. Walls are 4x3 blocks: left edge, two repeating middles, right edge. Floors repeat a 2x2 pattern. Grounds pick one of their 1x1 variants per tile. A prop may have a "board" entry (blocks_move, blocks_sight, cover, hp, tags) for the combat arena; a prop without one blocks movement and gives no cover (see combat-board.md).
